title: Blue as most frequent healthcare branding primary color
statement:
Blue is the most frequently used primary color in healthcare branding and interfaces because of its associations with trust, calm, and competence across age groups.

Options:
- Standard health blue: #1E90FF mid-blue (fits: telehealth, clinic)
- Healing teal: #20B2AA light sea green (fits: wellness, mental health)
- Clean clinical: #F5F5F5 off-white + blue accent (fits: sterile, professional)
- Nature health: #228B22 green primary (fits: holistic, recovery)
appliesWhen: Applies to: health. Audience: adults, seniors, parents.
